integrity: The proof is analytic and uses no finite experiment as evidence for the universal statement. The motivating note explicitly states the conjecture; the foundational Abraham–Kovač paper for the same object lists primary MSC 51M04 and 51N20. A residual risk remains for unindexed or differently phrased prior work. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result settles only the absence of exterior solutions of Nicollier's distance equation; it does not provide new coordinates for \(X(5626)\) and does not claim an analogous theorem for general polygons or convex bodies.
title: Nicollier's exterior-solution conjecture for the gravitational-center equation
